title_en: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
title_zh: AndroidFlux：评估与奖励建模移动多模态智能体的故障恢复能力
summary_en: AndroidFlux is a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld that restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, enabling fair comparison of agents from identical device states and histories. A complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. The authors release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Evaluations show recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.
summary_zh: AndroidFlux 是一个基于 AndroidWorld 构建的故障恢复基准，它将记录轨迹恢复到首个可恢复错误之前、之时和之后的受控检查点，使不同智能体从相同的设备状态和历史继续执行，从而实现公平比较。一个互补的奖励建模基准利用下游 rollout 结果评估恢复动作偏好。作者还发布了一个离线强化学习（RL）数据集，可同时提升错误恢复能力和整体任务成功率。评估表明，恢复性能与干净启动成功率仅部分相关，且显式推理仅对使用 GUI 领域特定 RL 训练的模型有帮助。
content_en: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.
content_zh: 移动端多模态智能体通常从干净的初始状态按任务成功率来评估，这无法单独衡量其从中间错误中恢复的能力。由于移动环境动态变化，通用的移动端智能体必须即使在意外状态和未见环境中也能稳健地完成任务。这要求了解智能体何时何地出错，以及它能否从错误及后续状态中恢复。为评估这一能力，我们提出 AndroidFlux，一个基于 AndroidWorld 构建的故障恢复基准。AndroidFlux 将记录的轨迹恢复到首次可恢复错误之前、之时和之后的受控检查点，使不同智能体从相同的设备状态和历史继续执行。在这些检查点上，一个互补的奖励建模基准利用下游 rollout 结果评估恢复动作偏好。我们进一步发布了一个离线强化学习（RL）数据集，可同时提升错误恢复能力和整体任务成功率。我们的评估表明，恢复性能仅与干净启动成功率部分相关，并且显式推理仅对使用 GUI 领域特定 RL 训练的模型有帮助。
